why: Stack independence, demonstrated rather than asserted (FR-4, NFR-6). The target is a Python 3 service with NO package.json anywhere: a Python gate, a Python service with HTTP readiness, a Python packaged command, and a POSIX shell observation script asserting a before/after invariant over persisted state. Every stack specific enters through .specwitness/config.yaml and nowhere else. This embodies no defect class from brief section 7 -- it is the FR-4 proof, and the first execution in this repository against a target that is not a Node project, so a Node assumption in gate resolution, service startup or observation would surface here and nowhere else. PASS is the expected outcome; a failure here is a candidate stack-neutrality leak in the product, not a broken fixture. The stderrContains entries pin one line per EVIDENCE KIND -- gate, http, command, observation -- because the AC names gates, services AND observations, and without them a gate that silently never ran would still produce PASS with three passing criteria. They were derived from the renderer source (src/report/terminal.ts evidenceLines, and src/cli/commands/verify.ts which sends the terminal report to stderr under --json), never copied from a run.
